claims.text: Many reviewers find these loofah pads effective at exfoliating and leaving skin softer and smoother.
Reviewers frequently praise the low price and good value.
Several reviewers note the pads are gentler or softer than expected, though one found them overly soft and another found them rough.
The elastic hand strap is convenient for grip, but some report it loses elasticity quickly.
A few reviewers mention durability concerns, including mold buildup when used with water and the need to replace them.
